observed_discontinuity: Frozen Bubble drawLevelNumber calls Character.forDigit. The game VM registered Ljava/lang/Character; with no methods, so the static invoke returned null instead of a digit character.
required_semantics: Radix below MIN_RADIX 2 or above MAX_RADIX 36 returns 0.
A negative digit or a digit greater than or equal to radix returns 0.
A digit below 10 returns the character '0' plus the digit.
A digit of 10 or more returns the character 'a' plus the digit minus 10.
The method is static and returns a char.

differences.description: Ljava/lang/Character; had no forDigit method, so invoke-static stored a null result.
differences.relevance: drawLevelNumber uses forDigit with radix 10 to obtain level digits before BubbleFont.paintChar. A null result is not the character '0' through '9'.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 Character.forDigit returns a digit character for radix 2..36 and a digit in range. AGR had no method, so the invoke returned null.

evidence.artifact: android-4.4.4_r2 libcore luni Character.forDigit returns 0 unless MIN_RADIX <= radix <= MAX_RADIX and 0 <= digit < radix. MIN_RADIX is 2 and MAX_RADIX is 36. A digit below 10 returns (char)(digit + '0'); otherwise (char)(digit + 'a' - 10). Frozen Bubble GameView.drawLevelNumber invokes Character.forDigit with radix 10.

Linux character-fordigit-host PASS. forDigit(0,10) is 48, forDigit(9,10) is 57, forDigit(10,10) is 0, forDigit(-1,10) is 0, forDigit(0,2) is 48, forDigit(1,2) is 49, forDigit(10,16) is 97, forDigit(15,16) is 102, forDigit(35,36) is 122, forDigit(36,36) is 0, forDigit(1,1) is 0, forDigit(1,37) is 0, forDigit(0,36) is 48. The registered method is static native shorty CII.
